reasons_for_scientific_invalidation.reason: 0/15 is not evidence that AICs cannot become inventions
reasons_for_scientific_invalidation.explanation: The 0/15 invention_candidate_rate was produced by an uncalibrated adversarial gate using Llama-3.1-8B as both generation and adjudication model. This is circular: the same model generated the inventions and then killed them. The result reflects the model's self-consistency, not an independent scientific evaluation.

reasons_for_scientific_invalidation.reason: 96 adversarial kills had zero external evidence
reasons_for_scientific_invalidation.explanation: The V2 adversarial evaluator (Llama-3.1-8B) produced KILL verdicts across 7 dimensions for 15 architectures. None of these KILLs cited external evidence (published failure records, peer-reviewed papers, engineering standards, patent claims). The evaluator's own reasoning was treated as evidence, violating the boundary-condition evidence standard (V4 Correction 5).

reasons_for_scientific_invalidation.reason: prior-art references were not independently retrieved/verified
reasons_for_scientific_invalidation.explanation: The V2 prior-art assessment was performed by the same LLM that generated the invention. It produced patent numbers like 'US Patent 9,945,661 B2' and 'WO 2015/144444 A1' that were never retrieved from any real patent database. These are FABRICATED CITATIONS. The prior-art firewall (V4 Correction 10) was not enforced: no independent retrieval, no content hashes, no source URLs, no searched_universe_hash.

reasons_for_scientific_invalidation.reason: model was not calibrated against the validated evaluator chain
reasons_for_scientific_invalidation.explanation: The calibrated evaluator (evaluator_v1_frozen, prompt_hash 70bb690572d1fec1, ontology c8ae93b52fb2c09d, Mistral-only) was not used. Llama-3.1-8B was substituted as the adjudication model without calibration. No 35-case external-evidence calibration suite was run. The adversarial verdicts have unknown accuracy.

reasons_for_scientific_invalidation.reason: protocol freeze was not structurally before execution
reasons_for_scientific_invalidation.explanation: The V2 protocol (INVENTION_GENERATION_PROTOCOL_V2.json) was committed in the same commit as the V2 results. There is no cryptographic proof that the protocol was frozen before the first API call. The protocol-commit-precedes-results-commit invariant was not enforced.

reasons_for_scientific_invalidation.reason: generation and adjudication were not separated
reasons_for_scientific_invalidation.explanation: V4 Correction 7 requires separate models for generation (fast) and adjudication (calibrated strong). V2 used Llama-3.1-8B for both, creating a circular evaluation where the same model that generated the invention also judged it.

evidence: All hard-coded API keys removed from source code
Full pipeline executed (5 architectures, 3 refinement rounds, 7 adversarial dims)
Operational failures distinguished from scientific rejections
20/20 AICs attempted, 15 reached final gate, 5 had pipeline call failures

v2_artifacts_preservation.policy: All V2 artifacts are preserved unchanged as historical evidence of the failure mode

required_remediation_before_any_future_i: V4 corrections 5-8 must be implemented and tested (boundary evidence, prior-art firewall, adversarial_invalid, evidence ordering)
35-case adversarial calibration suite must be built with external evidence
Calibration must pass >=80% aggregate and >=70% in every critical category
Generation model must be separated from adjudication model
Calibrated evaluator (evaluator_v1_frozen, Mistral-only) must be used for adjudication
Protocol must be committed in a SEPARATE commit before any results commit
Prior-art references must originate from frozen prior-art retrieval subsystem (not LLM)
V3 corrected replay must be run on frozen V3 candidates (historical, not new synthesis)
do_NOT: interpret the 0/15 V2 result as evidence that AICs cannot become inventions
run another invention-generation experiment until calibration passes
use any V2 model-generated patent citation as prior-art evidence
substitute a weaker model or weaker evidence standard to make the experiment run
